label: Controls for comprehension by degrees of act, knowability and knowing
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with two beings (Bool; true alone INFINITE_1; both have intellect) and the degree scale Bool (false < true): (1) nonvacuity: all four premises and the sense bridge hold, the bridge 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being' holds, true comprehends itself in both senses and false COMPREHEND_2s itself; (2)-(5) each of the four premises omitted in turn, the other three hold and false (not INFINITE_1) COMPREHEND_2s true (INFINITE_1); parts 2 and 4 also show maximal knowability and the non-maximal-power premise each fail while the other holds; (6) with everything comprehending everything in the primitive sense, the COMPREHEND_2 bridge holds and the sense bridge and the COMPREHEND_1 bridge fail; (7) with nothing comprehending in the primitive sense, the sense bridge holds and its converse fails; (8) on any Preorder scale with no maximum, 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 has a maximal degree of act' entails that nothing is INFINITE_1. Statements about these interpretations only.
